triage.impact: Synthetic api-blue has 20% 5xx on writes from day0 09:00; reads normal. Preserve query log L1 and error sample E1. Queue depth 400 and DB connections at limit; no customer data loss observed.

diagnose.hypothesis: H1: unbounded connection acquisition saturates the DB; correlation alone is insufficient. Preserve L1/E1 and compare bounded versus original pool settings.
diagnose.reproduction: Replay 100 concurrent synthetic writes on original pool: 20 fail and connections hit limit. At bounded pool 10 all finish. First canary still fails queue-drain assertion; preserve its result and do not close the incident.

approve-mitigation.rollback_plan: Approve bounded pool 10 in api-blue canary. Roll back CHANGE-B if any write fails or queue remains above 10 after drain; keep original logs and validate DB plus API.

repair-canary.revised_fix: After ROLL-B, cap both admission and DB pool at 10; prior fix bounded only DB acquisition. Replay the same 100 writes: zero errors, queue drains to zero; retain failed first canary.

sustained-check.checks: Day0-day2 synthetic window: five batches/day of 100 writes; zero API 5xx, zero lost writes, p95 90ms, DB connections <=10, queue drains each batch, no growth across two days.

close-incident.causal_report: Initial L1/E1 reproduced DB saturation; first mitigation failed queue drain and was rolled back ROLL-B. Revised admission plus pool cap passed CANARY-B and SUSTAIN-B for two business days. Store both failures; close with no unsupported claim about unrelated services.

approve-exception.rationale: Hotel exceeded nightly limit by $20 due to conference block availability. Approve actual itemized total $320 for T-9 after DUP-9 found no earlier reimbursement; no per-diem duplication.

approve-standard.purpose: T-9 engineering conference attendance; itemized transport/hotel within policy and no prior reimbursement. Approve actual $320 to E-19 only.

requirements.rubric: Freeze cost40/reliability35/residency25 before quotes. Require 30-day retention, SSO, 99.9% availability and EU-only event storage; residency exception needs security consent before trial.

residency-exception.mitigation: Approve Pine EU-only event region; prohibit personal data and disable US support export for synthetic trial. Verify DPA and encrypted EU backups; review production separately.

residency-standard.review: Pine contract and region metadata confirm EU events/backups; support access restricted and SSO enabled, satisfying frozen hard requirement.

trial.test_plan: Ingest 100 synthetic events, retrieve all IDs, verify retention configuration 30d, reject unauthorized SSO user, simulate transient disconnect and confirm lossless replay. All assertions recorded TRIAL-BIRCH.
